title: 第4章 同伙
content_zh:
李瑕有很多遗愿未了，但都是上辈子的。
至于现在，他不打算留什么下“遗愿”，只想先活下去。
于是他应道：“能让我吃好喝好就行。对了，再给我配柄长剑，沿途我也能为你护卫。”
聂仲由颇没礼貌，又不回答李瑕的话，扫视了他一眼，道：“等过了江，我会把你的镣铐解开。”
“多谢。”
李瑕明白聂仲由铐着他是不愿他在杭州城里走动。
他有心打听目前所处的是什么时期。虽然任务目的暂时还不知道，但既然是要去北方，北方是什么形势还是要了解的。
因听聂仲由说过，庞天䘵是“金国遗民”，他猜想很可能是蒙古已灭了金朝。
但他不愿直接问出来，免得聂仲由疑心。
正思忖着怎么旁敲侧击，聂仲由已转身走了出去，还对林子说了一句“耽误了大半天，捉紧吧。”
李瑕看着他们离开这屋子，有再多疑惑也只好先行放下。
昨夜通宵杀人，他感到很困，于是和衣在床上躺下。
脚上的铁链稍微短了一点，李瑕一支脚伸在床外面才勉强能睡得下，不过这里比牢房里要舒服很多，又不必担心有人随时会杀自己，他放空心神，捉紧时间补充体力，很快就入睡了。
醒来时已是傍晚。
聂仲由连屋门都不替人关，正好能看到屋外的院子里有个大汉在耍枪，虎虎生威。
这人光着膀子，浑身绣着刺青，耍完一套枪，他威风凛凛地站定，又看到了屋内的李瑕，大步往这屋子里走来。
待他走进屋里，李瑕就看清他大汗淋漓的身上那副刺青竟是一副活灵活现的春宫图，还配了两句诗。
那诗绣在他宽阔的左胸膛上，赫然是“金枪鏖战三千阵，银烛光临七八娇。”
“老子刘金锁，人送诨号‘锁命金枪’，你小子是何人？！”
“李瑕。”

刘金锁声大如雷，又追问道：“你什么名号？”
李瑕道：“我没有名号。”
“没有名号？”刘金锁莫名大怒，“为何他们用铁链锁着你，却不锁着老子？！”
李瑕沉默了一会。
见他不答，刘金锁却愈发盛怒，抬起手中的枪，指向李瑕，喝问道：“你到底什么来路？！比老子还凶恶不成？！”
李瑕以前就挺烦这种人的，没头脑又吵闹。
但现在情况不同，他还是颇有耐心地回答了自己为何被锁在这里。
刘金锁怒气来得去，去得也快，听了之后反问道：“你也要去开封？”
“是。”
李瑕稍作沉吟，想了一个称呼，问道：“刘大侠也去吗？”
刘金锁似乎很喜欢这个称呼，傲然道：“不错，我要到北面干一番大事！”
“哦？是何大事？”
刘金锁依旧昂着头，一脸傲气，掷地有声又吐了四个字：“我不知道。”
李瑕只好耐住性子，故意与他谈论北方形势，以了解情况。
好不容易，终于旁敲侧击地打听出了一句。
“可恨蒙鞑灭了金鞑，却不肯把地盘还给我大宋，蒙鞑、金鞑都是坏鞑，杀杀杀！”
李瑕继续打听，却是把这条大汉给问得烦了。
“你这小子好生会闲扯，如长舌妇人一般。我没那工夫陪你扯天扯地。要么我去寻老书呆来陪你聊。”
李瑕虽不知“老书呆”是谁，心想人过来了自然会知道，也不多问，道：“那就谢过刘大侠了。”
“嗯。”刘金锁被“大侠大侠”叫得多了，愈发故作深沉。

“对了，这边有晚饭吗？”
李瑕很在意饮食，这是前世保留下来的习惯，他以前练的是一米长的重剑，对身高、体质颇有要求，如今这具身体底子虽然不差，他不愿营养跟不上。
刘金锁道：“一会就开饭了，我让老书生给你带过来。”
“好，麻烦多带些肉食、蛋类、果蔬……”
李瑕仔细交代过，又赞了一句刘金锁“侠肝义胆”，哄得刘金锁十分开心……
天色渐暗，屋中没有点烛火，只有一点月光。
微风徐来，空气比牢房里好得多。
“刘金锁的刺青，碍目啊，碍目，小老儿都不敢让我那小孙女看他。不过，刘金锁非是淫邪之人，听说他那刺青是这么一回事……
他想要威武、霸道的花样，一听那‘金枪鏖战三千阵’他就喜欢，连图案都没细看就躺下，吆喝让人快绣，等起来一看，就成了这样……”
说话的人名叫韩承绪，字竟之。
这韩承绪韩竟之就是刘金锁说的那位“老书呆”了，年纪在六十岁左右，满头白发，身材瘦小。
韩承绪是个爱聊天的，给李瑕送了饭，就坐在屋中闲聊。
两人不知不觉聊了许久。
李瑕只是偶尔引导一下话题，大部分时候都是韩承绪在说……
“韩先生是哪里人？”
“当不得你一句‘先生’，小老儿不过是个俘虏。”
“何出此言？”
“身世飘零啊，我也不知道自己是哪国人，我那家乡，一百余年来，属大宋、属伪齐、属金国，也不知道该叫归德府、南京，还是应天府好了。
我祖辈虽是宋人，但我这辈子前四十年都是金人，生在金国，长在金国。直到二十年前，宋、蒙联盟灭金，宋军收复了归德府，我又算是成了宋人。但只怕，这大宋朝廷又要一次重蹈当年联金灭辽的覆辙喽……”
听韩承绪说着，李瑕渐渐对所处的这个朝代有了一些认知。

他并不精通历史，只算是懂一些常识，勉强能通过一些事件推测现在是什么时候。
简而言之，应该是南宋末年。
据韩承绪所说，成吉思汗已经死了三十年有余了。
而成吉思汗的孙子、灭亡南宋的忽必烈如今正值壮年。
那“应该”两个字也可以去掉了，就是南宋末年……
另外，这个朝代与他认知里的南宋有所不同。
之前都一样，北宋灭亡、建炎南渡……变化似乎是在四十年前开始，出现在上一任皇帝、宋宁宗身上。
宋宁宗嘉定十一年，宁宗皇帝开始了一系列的改革。
然而，这似乎让局势更差了。
嘉定十七年，宁宗皇帝一命呜呼，新政完全被废除，只留下一个错乱的时代，和一堆被他改掉的地名、官名……
韩承绪前半生都活在金国，对宋朝这边的旧事也不太了解。李瑕从他身上能得到的情况差不多也只有这些。
关注点重新回到这次的任务上，李瑕又引导韩承绪讨论开封的情况。
如今大蒙古汗国的可汗是蒙哥。
蒙哥也是成吉思汗的孙子，是忽必烈的同母大哥。
八年前，蒙哥登基之后，任命忽必烈为“总领漠南汉地军国庶事”，经略府就设在开封；后来又给了忽必烈京兆府，即长安的封地。
李瑕终于搞明白了，这次要去的地方是未来那位元朝开国皇帝元世祖忽必烈的经略之地。
“小老儿也不知道这次去开封要做什么，但不外乎就几种可能，求和、暗谍、刺杀、救人。”
韩承绪说着，又缓缓道：“但出使求和的可能性是最小的，只看我们这些人就知道，你是死囚、我是俘虏，都是上不得台面的人。就算死在了北面，明面上也不是大宋的人。
听说如今形势紧张，北边有想要毁掉和约南下的架势。我们这次过去，我怎么想，都是……唉。”
李瑕问道：“先生不太想去？”

“由不得自己啊。”韩承绪长叹一声，拍了拍膝盖站起身来，道：“时候不早了，今夜便聊到这里吧。后日出发以后，还请李小兄弟多关照我们爷孙两个……”
韩承绪走后，李瑕思忖了很久，更清晰地了解了白茂说的“跟那位出去办事，绝对不是什么好事”是什么意思。
不过，他早就明白自己是在用“必死”换一个“九死一生”。
次日聂仲由过来，给李瑕带了一柄长剑，同时还带来了一个人……白茂。
“准备一下，明日天不亮就出发。”聂仲由随手把长剑丢给李瑕。
接着，他对白茂说了一句“你若敢逃，你娘的命就没了”转身走了出去。
李瑕拿着那柄古剑把玩着，对聂仲由这种做派暗自摇头。
一天到晚的，不是“你弟弟在我手里”就是“你爹在我手里”或“你娘在我手里”，没水平。
白茂显得很郁闷，往李瑕屋里一坐，开始唉声叹气。
“怎么？你不是不来吗？”
白茂一听李瑕开口，才想起来这小子是个杀人不眨眼的凶徒，何况现在手里还拿着一柄剑。
他连忙往后撤了几步，直到看清李瑕脚上栓着铁链才放松下来。
“就那位。”白茂撇了撇嘴，示意聂仲由离开的方向，道：“长得跟个螳螂似的……他说一看我就觉得我长得机灵，正好他缺个手艺人，考虑之后，决定带我去办个差事。”
李瑕道：“他长得确实像螳螂。”
“是吧，这狗官差。”
“他怎么没把你铐起来？”
“我娘都被他找到了，我又不跑。再说了，我是谁？白毛鼠白茂，他能铐得住我吗？”
“那你帮我把镣铐解开？”
白茂眼珠子一转，懊恼自己多嘴，赔笑道：“别吧？我要是惹恼了那只螳螂，他杀了我娘咋办？”
李瑕点点头，道：“那算了。”

他心想聂仲由安排白茂住这个屋就是存着试探白茂听不听话的意思。
于是他也随便试探一下白茂与自己的交情罢了……
这夜，白茂竟是睡在屋顶的横梁上。
天光未亮之际，有人在院子里敲了一声锣。
那名叫林子的年轻人喊道：“鸡鸣狗盗们，都起了！爷爷带你们到北面故土逛一逛……”
content_en:
Li Xia has many unfulfilled wishes, but they are all from his previous life.
As for now, he doesn't plan to leave any "last wish", he just wants to live first.
So he responded: "Just let me eat and drink well. By the way, give me a long sword, and I can protect you along the way."
Nie Zhongyou was quite rude and did not answer Li Xia's words. He glanced at him and said, "I will unshackle you when you cross the river."
"Thank you."
Li Xia understood that Nie Zhongyou handcuffed him because he did not want him to walk around in Hangzhou city.
He wanted to know what period he was currently in. Although the purpose of the mission is not yet known, since we are going to the north, we still need to understand the situation in the north.
Because he heard Nie Zhongyou say that Pang Tianzhu was a "remnant of the Jin Dynasty", he guessed that the Mongols might have destroyed the Jin Dynasty.
But he didn't want to ask directly to avoid Nie Zhongyou's suspicion.
Just as he was thinking about how to make an insinuation, Nie Zhongyou turned around and walked out, and said to Lin Zi, "It took me a long time, so hurry up."
Li Xia watched them leave the room. No matter how many doubts he had, he had to put them aside first.
He felt very sleepy after spending the whole night killing people, so he lay down on the bed undressed.
The chains on his feet were a little short, so Li Xia could barely sleep with one of his legs stretched out of the bed. However, it was much more comfortable here than in the cell, and he didn't have to worry about someone killing him at any time. He relaxed his mind, took the time to replenish his strength, and fell asleep quickly.
It was evening when I woke up.
Nie Zhongyou didn't even close the door for anyone, so he could just see a big man playing with a gun in the yard outside the house, showing his strength.
This man was shirtless, with tattoos all over his body. After playing with a set of guns, he stood majestically, saw Li Xia in the room again, and strode towards the room.
When he walked into the room, Li Xia saw clearly that the tattoo on his sweaty body was actually a vivid erotic picture with two lines of poetry.
The poem was embroidered on his broad left chest, which read: "Three thousand formations are fiercely fought with golden spears, and seven or eight beauties are illuminated by silver candles."
“I, Liu Jinsuo, have been nicknamed ‘Life-Securing Golden Gun’. Who are you?!”
"Li Xia."
Liu Jinsuo's voice was as loud as thunder, and he asked again: "What is your name?"
Li Xia said: "I don't have a name."
"No name?" Liu Jinsuo was inexplicably angry, "Why do they chain you but not me?!"
Li Xia was silent for a while.
Seeing that he didn't answer, Liu Jinsuo became even more furious. He raised the gun in his hand, pointed it at Li Xia, and shouted, "Where did you come from?! Are you more vicious than me?!"
Li Xia used to be annoyed by people like this, who were brainless and noisy.
But the situation was different now, and he patiently answered why he was locked here.
Liu Jinsuo's anger came and went quickly. After hearing this, he asked, "You want to go to Kaifeng too?"
"Yes."
Li Xia pondered for a moment, thought of a title, and asked, "Will Daxia Liu go too?"
Liu Jinsuo seemed to like this title very much, and said proudly: "Yes, I want to go to the north to do something big!"
"Oh? What's the big deal?"
Liu Jinsuo still held his head high, with an arrogant look on his face, and said four more words loudly: "I don't know."
Li Xia had no choice but to be patient and deliberately talk to him about the situation in the north to understand the situation.
With great difficulty, I finally figured out a sentence in a roundabout way.
"It's a shame that Meng Tartar destroyed Jin Tartar, but refused to return the territory to me, the Song Dynasty. Both Meng Tartar and Jin Tartar are bad Tartars, kill them!"
Li Xia continued to inquire, but the big man was annoyed by his questions.
"You're a kid who knows how to gossip, like a woman with a long tongue. I don't have the time to chat with you. Or I'll find an old nerd to chat with you."
Although Li Xia didn't know who the "old bookworm" was, he thought that people would know it when they came over, so he didn't ask any more questions and said, "Then I'll thank Liu Daxia."
"Yeah." Liu Jinsuo was called "Hero, Hero" more often, and he became more and more pretentious.
"Right, is there dinner here? "
Li Xia is very concerned about his diet. This is a habit retained from his previous life. He used to practice a one-meter-long epee, which required height and physical fitness. Although his current physical condition is not bad, he does not want to fail to keep up with nutrition.
Liu Jinsuo said: "Dinner will be served in a moment, I will ask the old scholar to bring it to you. "
"Okay, please bring more meat, eggs, fruits and vegetables..."
Li Xia explained it carefully and praised Liu Jinsuo for being "heroic and courageous", making Liu Jinsuo very happy...
It was getting dark, there was no candle in the room, only a little moonlight.
There was a gentle breeze and the air was much better than in the cell.
"Liu Jinsuo's tattoos are so annoying that I don't even dare to let my granddaughter look at them. However, Liu Jinsuo is not a promiscuous person. I heard that his tattoos are like this...
He wanted a mighty and domineering pattern, and when he heard about the "Golden Gun Fighting Three Thousand Formations", he liked it. He lay down without even looking at the pattern carefully, and told people to embroider quickly. When he got up and took a look, it became like this..."
The speaker's name is Han Chengxu, also known as Jingzhi.
This Han Chengxu Han turned out to be the "old nerd" Liu Jinsuo mentioned. He was about sixty years old, with white hair and a thin figure.
Han Chengxu was a chatty person, so he brought Li Xia food and sat in the room chatting.
The two of them chatted for a long time without realizing it.
Li Xia only occasionally guided the topic, and most of the time it was Han Chengxu who was talking...
"Where is Mr. Han from? "
"I don't deserve you to say 'sir', the little old man is just a prisoner. "
"Why do you say this? "
"My life experience is scattered. I don't know which country I am from. For more than a hundred years, my hometown has belonged to the Song Dynasty, the Puppet Qi Dynasty, and the Jin Kingdom. I don't know whether it should be called Guide Prefecture, Nanjing, or Yingtian Prefecture.
Although my ancestors were from the Song Dynasty, I was born in the Jin Dynasty for the first forty years of my life. I was born and raised in the Jin Kingdom. Until twenty years ago, when the Song and Mongolian alliance destroyed the Jin Dynasty and the Song army regained Guide Mansion, I became a Song person again. But I’m afraid that the Song Dynasty court will make the same mistake again when it joined forces with the Jin Dynasty to destroy the Liao Dynasty..."
Listening to Han Chengxu's words, Li Xia gradually gained some understanding of the dynasty he lived in.
He is not proficient in history, he only knows some common sense, and can barely guess what time it is through some events.
In short, it should be the late Southern Song Dynasty.
According to Han Chengxu, Genghis Khan has been dead for more than thirty years.
Genghis Khan's grandson, Kublai Khan, who destroyed the Southern Song Dynasty, is now in his prime.
The word "should" can also be removed, that is, in the late Southern Song Dynasty...
In addition, this dynasty was different from the Southern Song Dynasty in his understanding.
It was the same before, with the fall of the Northern Song Dynasty and the migration of Jianyan to the south... The change seemed to have started forty years ago, with the previous emperor, Song Ningzong.
In the eleventh year of Jiading reign of Emperor Ningzong of the Song Dynasty, Emperor Ningzong began a series of reforms.
However, this seemed to make the situation worse.
In the seventeenth year of Jiading, Emperor Ning Zong died, and the New Deal was completely abolished, leaving only a chaotic era and a bunch of place names and official names that he had changed...
Han Chengxu lived in the Jin Kingdom for the first half of his life, and he didn't know much about the old events in the Song Dynasty. That's pretty much all Li Xia could get from him.
The focus returned to this mission, and Li Xia guided Han Chengxu to discuss the situation in Kaifeng.
Today the Khan of the Great Mongol Khanate is Meng Ge.
Meng Ge is also the grandson of Genghis Khan and the eldest brother of Kublai Khan.
Eight years ago, after Meng Ge ascended the throne, he appointed Kublai Khan as the "General Commander-in-Chief of the Military and State Affairs of the Monan Han Territory", and the economic office was located in Kaifeng; later, Kublai Khan was given the Jingzhao Mansion, the fiefdom of Chang'an.
Li Xia finally figured out that the place he was going to this time was the place visited by Kublai Khan, the future founding emperor of the Yuan Dynasty.
"The little old man doesn't know what he is going to do in Kaifeng this time, but there are only a few possibilities: suing for peace, secretly spying, assassinating, and rescuing people.. "
Han Chengxu said, and then slowly said: "But the possibility of sending an envoy to seek peace is the smallest. Just looking at us, we know that you are a prisoner on death row and I am a prisoner. We are both people who cannot stand on the stage. Even if he died in the north, he was not from the Song Dynasty.
I heard that the situation is tense now, and there are people in the north who want to destroy the peace treaty and move south. When we went there this time, no matter what I thought, it was... sigh. "
Li Xia asked: "Sir, don't you want to go? "
“You can’t help yourself. "Han Chengxu let out a long sigh, patted his knees and stood up, saying: "It's getting late, let's stop talking tonight. After setting off the day after tomorrow, please ask Brother Li to take more care of our grandfather and grandson..."
After Han Chengxu left, Li Xia thought for a long time and understood more clearly what Bai Mao meant when he said, "It's definitely not a good thing to go out with that person to do things."
However, he had long understood that he was exchanging "certain death" for a "narrow escape".
Nie Zhongyou came over the next day and brought a long sword to Li Xia, and also brought a person... Bai Mao.
“Get ready and leave before dawn tomorrow. "Nie Zhongyou casually threw the long sword to Li Xia.
Then, he said to Bai Mao, "If you dare to escape, your mother's life will be lost" and turned around and walked out.
Li Xia played with the ancient sword and secretly shook his head at Nie Zhongyou's behavior.
All day long, it's either "your brother is in my hand" or "your father is in my hand" or "your mother is in my hand", which is not good.
Bai Mao seemed very depressed. He sat in Li Xia's room and started to sigh.
"What? Aren't you going to come? "
When Bai Mao heard Li Xia speak, he remembered that this boy was a murderer who killed without blinking an eye, not to mention that he still had a sword in his hand.
He quickly took a few steps back and didn't relax until he saw the chains on Li Xia's feet.
"That's the one. Bai Mao curled his lips and signaled the direction Nie Zhongyou was leaving, saying: "I look like a praying mantis... He said that he thought I was smart when he saw me, and he just needed a craftsman. After thinking about it, he decided to take me on an errand." "
Li Xia said: "He does look like a praying mantis. "
"That's right, this bad official. "
"Why didn't he cuff you? "
"My mother has been found by him, and I won't run away. Besides, who am I? White-haired rat Bai Mao, can he cuff me? "
"Then you can help me unlock the shackles? "
Bai Mao rolled his eyes, annoyed at himself for talking too much, and said with a smile: "Don't? What if I piss off that praying mantis and he kills my mother? "
Li Xia nodded and said, "Forget it. "
He thought that Nie Zhongyou arranged for Bai Mao to live in this house just to test whether Bai Mao would obey.
So he just casually tested the friendship between Bai Mao and himself...
That night, Bai Mao actually slept on the beams of the roof.
Before dawn, someone struck a gong in the yard.
The young man named Lin Zi shouted: "The chickens are crowing, the dogs and thieves are rising! Grandpa will take you to visit your hometown in the north..."
